name: supervisor
short_description: Unified service manager for Python/FastAPI projects with process supervision, cron scheduling, monitoring, and Caddy integration.
long_description: Supervisor is a comprehensive service management platform designed for Python and FastAPI projects. It provides process supervision with automatic crash recovery, cron job scheduling with execution history tracking, real-time resource monitoring (CPU/memory/disk usage), AI-powered auto-fix capabilities using Robot, security scanning for exposed services, and Caddy reverse proxy integration with subdomain-based routing. The system includes a web dashboard at port 9900 for management and monitoring, persistent SQLite database for logs and metrics, and background job execution for long-running operations. Projects can be onboarded via AI analysis which automatically determines their run configuration, and the system supports live log viewing, metrics visualization, and service control from a unified interface.

modules.description: FastAPI application with REST API endpoints for service/cron management, log viewing, metrics, auto-fix triggers, and Caddy configuration.
Process manager for starting, stopping, and restarting services with stdout/stderr capture, crash detection, and automatic restart with exponential backoff.
Resource monitoring system that periodically collects CPU, memory, and disk usage statistics and manages cleanup of old logs and metrics.
Cron job scheduler and executor that manages periodic task execution based on cron expressions with execution history and resource tracking.
Peewee ORM database models for services, logs, metrics, cron jobs, fix attempts, and execution history.
Configuration management using environment variables with sensible defaults for paths, server settings, Caddy, monitoring intervals, and auto-fix behavior.
Auto-fix integration using Robot AI to diagnose and fix service errors with automatic backup/restore capability and fix attempt tracking.
Robot AI integration for project onboarding, security scanning, and interactive chat assistance with prompt templating and service context.
Caddy reverse proxy configuration generation with subdomain-based routing and admin API communication for live config reloading.
Background job tracking system for async operation status monitoring with job state management and result persistence.
Frontend core utilities including state management, API client, tab/modal handling, and general UI utilities.
Service management UI for starting, stopping, restarting services and triggering security scans.
Monitoring UI for log viewing, real-time metrics charts, and fix attempt history display.
Cron job management interface for scheduling, editing, and viewing execution history of periodic tasks.
Main HTML dashboard template with tabs for services, monitoring, cron jobs, Caddy config, and AI chat interface.
